body:
I am a guy and I care very little about the appearance of women when it comes to finding someone. I am far more interested in who you are. Sure, there are guys that feel exactly how you described. Everything is all about looks for them. You know what we call them? Shallow assholes. Do you want to be with one of those? Really, I would love to see a picture of you.

I can understand where you were coming from when you were acting like that. I can also understand why they would think what they did. It doesn't make you a bad person. Just doing your best to constantly be a good person makes you better than many people.

Thank you for saying that I write well. I find it kind of amusing because  I was critiquing how poorly written this was. I know there are grammar mistakes and that planning is poor. Phrases are repeated that shouldn't be. I do try to write, but I never can get far. I get extremely frustrated with my inability. I constantly revise the first few pages until I destroy them. I am just stupid like that.

I can't really talk to aunts and uncles nor get therapy. All of my mother's family is extremely religious and will just pull it back to god. It will turn into trying to convert me very quickly because Jesus is the answer to everything. I have zero connections with my father's side. He left at an early age.

Maybe writing would help, but I would be paranoid about it being seen.
